description: Which medical institutions were added to, changed in, removed from or returned to MHLW's list of medical institutions accepting foreign patients since a date (this service's own record of list versions; MHLW keeps none)? Optional prefecture and change_type filters. Free window: last 30 days. A public-service listing, not an enforcement list: removals are dated, and no reason is inferred.

change_type.description: Optional filter: added, modified, removed_from_list, reappeared

prefecture.description: Optional filter: prefecture name, JIS code or local government code

since.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time with time zone, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z

name: foreign_patient_hospital_changes

changes.description: Changes observed by this service between list versions, oldest first.

history_window.description: Free history window applied to this answer.

clamped.description: true when requested_since was earlier than the free window and the answer covers only the window.

free_days.description: Days of recorded history served free of charge.

older_history.description: Status of recorded history older than the free window.

requested_since.description: The since you asked for (normalized to ISO 8601).

served_since.description: The since actually applied: requested_since, or the start of the free window if requested_since was earlier.

official_check.description: Read first: Listing as published by MHLW on the date shown; it does not guarantee that the hospital will accept a given patient or offer a given language at a given time. Not medical advice. Call the hospital before visiting; in an emergency call 119.

provenance.description: Freshness receipts for every upstream source used.

items.description: Freshness receipt for one upstream source.

fetch_status.description: found / empty / stale / unavailable / unsupported (see catalog fetch_status_values).

retrieved_at.description: When this service retrieved the upstream data (null if unknown).

source.description: Publisher and URL of the upstream document or dataset.

upstream_updated_at.description: Update time stated by the upstream, or null when it states none.

source.description: Where the answer comes from: MHLW page and file, MHLW's dates on the page, and when this service last fetched it.

terms.description: URL of the terms of service.

tracking_since.description: When this service first loaded the list. Changes before it were not observed.

title: Changes in the MHLW foreign-patient hospital list
